transcript: You've been eating avocados wrong, and you're missing out on probably 70% of the nutrients, or even more. The pit, the thing you mercilessly stab before discarding it into the trash, is one of the most powerful anti-inflammatory ancient medicines on Earth, stronger than turmeric, stronger than green tea. Let me show you why the hardest part is often the one that heals you fastest. Most people do not see this, but much of the antioxidants are actually within the seed. The pit contains tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, quiet warriors that work to fight what harms the body. Some studies suggest these compounds may affect harmful cells, while leaving the healthy ones untouched. So, how do you use it? Cut the avocado, remove the pit, and rinse it. Let it dry for a day or two, until the skin begins to peel. Then carefully chop it into pieces with a heavy knife. It is tougher than it looks. Add a small amount to smoothies, soups, or teas. It is bitter. So mix it with berries, maybe even half a banana. And remember, healing is not in doing more, but in doing things with awareness, with patience. If you are ready to take your life to the next level, my friend, my ebook, Time to Heal, is waiting for you, in the link on my profile. And if this message spoke to you, comment heal below.
